description: Search the pulsar catalog by free text — pulsar, the free GPLv3 compressor, its closed-embed exception, and the Silesia measurement. Read-only; returns matching entries with name, price, notes, and links. Use to find an entry by keyword; use pulsar_get when you already know the entry id.

q.description: Free-text query matched against entry id, name, notes, price, and URL. Omit or send an empty string to list every entry in the catalog.

name: pulsar_search
